text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of a temporary accessible parking space on the east side of Tippett Road. The installation of the proposed accessible parking space will address the needs of a local resident during the COVID-19 pandemic crisis.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing standing prohibition in effect at all times on the east side of Tippett Road, between a point 53 metres south of Wilson Avenue and a point 58.5 metres south of Wilson Avenue. 2. Authorized the installation of a temporary on-street accessible parking space on the east side of Tippett Road, between a point 53 metres south of Wilson Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further south, during the COVID-19 crisis. 3. Authorized that the standing prohibition on Tippett Road, between a point 53 metres south of Wilson Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further south, be reinstated when COVID -19 emergency measures are no longer in effect.
